defect_location.notes: CVE-2017-7407: --write-out 以 $ 变量结尾时读取越界（CVE 描述: reading a workstation screen ... obtain sensitive information from process memory via a --write-out argument ending in a variable without terminator）。

source.simplification: 剥离 curl 工具 write-out 全部变量类型，保留『变量解析循环缺少缓冲区终止检查』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: --write-out 参数以未闭合的 %{ 结尾，变量扫描越过堆缓冲
